title: xmltojson action
description: Converts an XML body to JSON as json-lib (Camel's xmljson) does: attributes as @name, namespace declarations as @xmlns, text beside attributes or children as #text, elements with one name and elements that hold only such elements as arrays, the root element left out.

forceTopLevelObject.title: Force top-level object
forceTopLevelObject.description: Keep the root element: the result is {"root": ...}

skipWhitespace.title: Skip whitespace
skipWhitespace.description: Whitespace between elements does not make an element an array of its children, and an element with only text and attributes is null

trimSpaces.title: Trim spaces
trimSpaces.description: Trim the whitespace around text and attribute values

removeNamespacePrefixes.title: Remove namespace prefixes
removeNamespacePrefixes.description: Name elements and attributes without their prefix

typeHints.title: Type hints
typeHints.description: The attributes type (number, integer, float, boolean, string, function) and class (object, array) set the JSON type, and null="true" makes it null; they are left out of the result. Without, they are attributes like any other (json_type and json_class are the hints) and all values are strings
